moonNotes: KR: lunar dates from KASI's official lunar-solar converter (astro.kasi.re.kr /life/lunc). Korea uses UTC+9, so a new moon between 15:00 and 16:00 UTC gives a different date than China: 2027 (Seollal 02-07 vs China 02-06) and 2028.

KR 2028 seollal CHANGED from ['01-26','01-25','01-27'] to ['01-27','01-26','01-28']: KASI converts lunar 2028-01-01 to solar 2028-01-27 (Thu); the new moon is 2028-01-26 15:12 UTC = 00:12 KST on Jan 27 (own Meeus calculation agrees). timeanddate and some Korean sites (dallyeok.com) say 01-26 (Chinese date); kholidayz.com says 01-27. The official 2028 holiday list (from KASI's 2028 calendar notes) is not published yet.

KR 2027 seollal last day 02-09 kept (substitute holiday). 2028+ use the plain 3-day span (no substitute days). timeanddate's Korea pages give Seollal 2030 as 02-04 and 2034 as 02-20; KASI says 02-03 and 02-19 (same as China), and KASI is used.
